assessmentQuestionVersion.name: PSE_RiskAssessment_Q4
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Complexity of infection prevention and control procedures
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Complex infection prevention and control procedures that involve multiple steps. May include: sterilization equipment onsite, instrument packaging, biological monitoring, sterile storage management, and multiple critical control points. High operator judgement and knowledge required. Moderately complex infection prevention and control procedures. Some cleaning and disinfection requirements. Combination of reusable and disposable equipment. Intermediate-level disinfection or higher required to be performed on site. Routine documentation may be required. Moderate operator judgement and knowledge required. Simple infection prevention and control procedures that involve limited cleaning and disinfection requirements. Primarily environmental sanitation control with low level disinfectants. Simple steps to reduce potential infection or injury. Leverages single-use/disposable equipment, pre-packaged sterile instruments. Few opportunities for operator error.
